coreml.required: macOS + CoreML framework + Xcode Command Line Tools
coreml.limitation: An iOS compiled model may not load on macOS; runtime errors are preserved

espresso_linear_cpu_experimental.limitation: Strict attested InnerProduct(62→1)+sigmoid subset; no Apple parity measurement

coreml_protobuf_cpu_experimental.limitation: Trees/pipelines and bounded MIL/dense operators; unsupported graphs fail explicitly; no Apple parity measurement

coreai_cpu.limitation: Apple .aimodel assets only; stateless static numeric tensors; no AFM weights included

apple_intelligence_generation.reason: Prompts and asset references do not supply AFM generation weights/runtime

interpretation: CPU predictions evaluate authentic Apple weights using the delivered independent graph evaluator. No Apple runtime, text generation, or semantic entity matching is claimed.
